statements.text: The prompt is statistical: it asks about homework times with expected variation across students.
A question can be statistical even when the exact list of times is not known yet.
It is only a fixed fact about one named student, so it is not statistical.

stem:
Vikram's teacher asks the class: "How many minutes do students in Class $7$C usually spend on homework each evening?"

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: The prompt expects variable homework times across Class 7C, so it is statistical even before data are collected. Statement 3 misreads it as one fixed fact.
